jobs.description: Du suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum oder Praxissemester, in dem du nicht nur Bewerbungen sortierst, sondern die Weiterentwicklung eines wachsenden Startups aktiv mitgestaltest, erkennst, wie Recruiting, Kommunikation und Markenaufbau zusammenwirken, und echten Einfluss auf die Unternehmenskultur nimmst? Dann bist du bei Think3DDD genau richtig! Bitte beachte: Die Stelle ist unvergütet und ausschließlich für Studierende mit Pflichtpraktikum bzw. Praxissemester geeignet. Wir sind ein mehrfach ausgezeichnetes Startup aus Berlin-Adlershof und entwickeln innovative Lösungen in den Bereichen 3D-Scan, 3D-Druck und Medizintechnik . Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir Praktikanten im Bereich Human Resources & Employer Branding. Die Position verbindet Recruiting, Kommunikation und Mitarbeitererlebnis. Aufgaben Recruiting & Bewerbermanagement – von der Stellenausschreibung über Screening bis zur Interviewbegleitung. Employer Branding & Kommunikation – Gestaltung von Kampagnen, Posts und Inhalten, die zeigen, was unsere Unternehmenskultur ausmacht. HR-Prozesse & Organisation – Einblick in Onboarding, Mitarbeiterkommunikation und Feedbackprozesse. Teamprojekte – Unterstützung bei internen Workshops, Employer-Branding-Events und Teamaktionen. Eigenverantwortung – Übernimm kleine HR-Projekte mit Unterstützung unseres Teams und entwickle dich fachlich wie persönlich weiter. Qualifikation Eingeschriebene Studierende in einem relevanten Studiengang, z. B.: BWL, Personalmanagement, Wirtschaftspsychologie Kommunikations- und Medienwissenschaften, Sozialwissenschaften, Kulturwissenschaften, Wirtschaftspädagogik oder in einem vergleichbaren Fach mit Bezug zu HR, Kommunikation oder Marketing Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Interesse an Menschen, Kommunikation und Unternehmenskultur. Kreatives Denken und Freude an Text, Social Media & Employer Branding. Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit und Organisationstalent. Lust, dich aktiv in ein wachsendes Startup einzubringen. Benefits Hands

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. We strive to be trusted partners and coaches to people at every level of the organization. This role spans three pillars — client-facing HRBP support, AI and operations, and employee relations support — and reports to the Director of HR Business Partners. jobs.title: Senior People Operations Manager
jobs.description: Wordsmith Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast. We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems. Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens. We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with. More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com , Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI. The Role You’ll own the operational backbone of our People function: payroll, global mobility, PEOs, commission and equity administration, HRIS, and the systems that keep everything in sync. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on clean operations, not a junior administrator position and not a People leadership seat. You'll operate the frameworks our leadership and Finance set (pay philosophy, salary bands, commission structure, equity strategy). Your job is to implement those decisions accurately and on time, with a clear audit trail, and with the judgment to stop or escalate anything that doesn't fit the framework or lacks proper approval. What You'll Do Own payroll controls and monthly validation across UK payroll, PEOs, and other employment models, with clean reconciliation to Finance each month Run visa and mobility operations end-to-end: sponsorships, relocations, compliance, right-to-work controls, and coordination with immigration advisers. jobs.description: About Karbon Karbon is the global leader in AI-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well-funded, ranked #1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List. We are seeking a player-coach style Manager of Talent Acquisition to own and elevate our global recruitment function. This is an owner-operator role: you will lead by example, personally closing roles, while managing a small team of recruiters and overseeing operational excellence across all open roles. Reporting to the VP of People, you will continuously refine how recruitment operates at Karbon - from candidate experience to process optimization, reporting, and AI integration. At the core, this role needs someone who: is obsessed with data and making recruitment more scientific a stickler for attention to detail a true talent partner not an order taker thinks AI-first and constantly look for ways to use AI to improve efficiency and delivery. Manage recruiting performance like a revenue organization, using ramp expectations, activity targets, and pipeline coverage ratios to drive predictable hiring outcomes. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it ! Context This role is open to support an ambitious hiring goal: growing the team by 50%. You will join a team of three recruiters, alongside Léa, our Talent Lead, with whom you will work hand in hand. The priority of the role is hiring tech profiles: Senior Fullstack Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Engineers. Your missions Hire the best tech talent Gather hiring needs with Hiring Managers, co-build scorecards, then write and publish job offers. Source active and passive candidates through multiple channels, with a strong focus on headhunting (LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, events). Assess candidates and run hiring processes end to end in Ashby, through to the offer. Ensure a high-quality candidate experience at every step. Support Hiring Managers Be their point of contact and help them define their team strategy through hiring. Contribute to the recruiting team Contribute, alongside Léa, to improving our hiring processes and our employer brand. You you are : 2 to 4 years of experience in recruiting. jobs.description: Talent Acquisition Partner / Corporate Recruiter Are you an experienced Corporate Recruiter who enjoys building strong relationships with hiring managers, finding the right talent and continuously improving the recruitment process? Join our HR team in De Lier and help us attract the people who will contribute to Priva’s future. It is about understanding the business, challenging hiring managers when needed, creating an excellent candidate experience and finding people who truly fit our organization and ambitions. As our new Corporate Recruiter, you will focus primarily on non-technical and commercial vacancies, including roles within account management, customer support, fulfillment and other business functions. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your recruitment portfolio while working closely with hiring managers, HR colleagues and other stakeholders across the organization. Climate for growth Priva develops innovative solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our technology helps customers create smarter, healthier and more sustainable environments while reducing the use of valuable resources such as energy and water. Our ambition is to contribute to a world where people can live and work in healthy, comfortable and sustainable environments. We call this creating a climate for growth. We encourage our employees to take ownership, think entrepreneurially and continuously look for ways to improve.
